sources.title: Angshul/LayerInteractions · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LayerInteractions A small Python API for order-2 interaction-aware transformer depth pruning of Hugging Face causal language models. This repository packages the method used in the accompanying experiments. It is source code, not a dataset and not a web service. Method Let D0 be the calibration NLL of the full model, Di the NLL after deleting layer i, and Dij the NLL after deleting layers i ...
